gloss: to debate; to discuss; to argue

definitions.gloss: to debate; to discuss formally; to argue a point
definitions.explanation: To engage in a structured exchange of differing opinions on a topic, typically with the aim of reaching a conclusion or persuading others.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{討論|とうろん}する。
⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A debate on the bill was held in the Diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{討論|とうろん}した。
examples.english: The students debated environmental issues vigorously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賛成派|さんせいは}→賛成派：30540_sanseiha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{反対派|はんたいは}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対決|たいけつ}→対決：12392_taiketsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The proponents and opponents faced off on a debate program.

notes:
Implies a formal, structured exchange with opposing viewpoints. More confrontational and formal than ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧, which can be more collaborative. Often associated with parliamentary debate, academic discussion, and TV debate shows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{討論会|とうろんかい}→討論会：25422_touronkai⟧: debate meeting, forum
- ⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: debate program
- ⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: party leaders' debate
- ⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧な⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: lively debate
- ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: public debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}する→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧: to discuss, to argue — broader; can be collaborative discussion or heated argument
- ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧: to talk it over — implies cooperative discussion to reach agreement
- ⟦{論争|ろんそう}→論争：03786_ronsou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispute, to be in controversy — implies prolonged, unresolved disagreement
